ms.report:
Introduction:
This report documents the successful completion of Milestone 1 for TxPipe's participation as an open-source contributor to the Mithril project. The milestone primarily focused on establishing the foundation for collaboration, including the commitment between the project team and Mithril's core development team, a comprehensive contingency plan for potential challenges, and the onboarding process.
1. Commitment Document:
The finalized Commitment Document has been successfully created and agreed upon by both the TxPipe project team and Mithril's core development team. This document outlines the terms, expectations, and responsibilities of each party in this collaborative effort. You can access the Commitment Document here.
2. Contingency Plan Documentation:
The Contingency Plan Documentation has been diligently prepared, detailing alternative strategies, resources, and timelines in case direct collaboration with Mithril's core team encounters challenges. This document ensures a proactive approach to overcoming potential hurdles. You can review the Contingency Plan Documentation here.
3. Contributor Selection Rationale and Onboarding Process:
A comprehensive text document has been compiled to provide insight into the rationale behind the selection of our contributor, Alexander Falcucci, and the successful completion of the onboarding process. This document sheds light on the contributor's technical competence, adaptability, leadership experience, and the successful assimilation into the Mithril project. You can find the text document here.
4. Proof-of-Onboarding Commit:
As evidence of the completion of the onboarding process, Alexander Falcucci has made a commit to the Mithril project repository. This commit signifies his active participation and integration into the project. You can verify the commit here.
5. Document Repository:

ms.report:
The culmination of the second milestone for the Mithril project represents a notable progress in our goal to contribute to the Mithril project and, at the same time, make it more accessible for future external contributions. This report provides a comprehensive overview of the milestone's outcomes and evidence of completion to aid the evaluation of the acceptance criteria.
Evidence of Milestone Completion
In this report and video overview, we go over the activity that the selected developer, Alexsander Falcucci, has executed as part of his involvement with the Mithril codebase.
Alexsander's direct contributions to the Mithril codebase are a testament to the project's collaborative nature. His main assignment consists of enhancing the interaction between Mithril and the Cardano Node by using Ouroboros protocols (TCP communication) directly instead of having to use the Cardano CLI through a shell process.
The complexity and length of this issue is large, so the team decided to divide it into smaller change units that can be merged independently. Alexsander has completed and merged 2 of these tasks which can be evaluated in the following pull-requests:
・Mithril Pull Request #1348 - enhance mithril/cardano node communication
・Mithril Pull Request #1403 - get datums using pallas observer 

These enhancements also required changes on an upstream related library called Pallas. Alexsander has engaged on extended to the Pallas project, where he successfully implemented changes and submitted the following pull requests:
・Pallas Pull Request #341 - Implement UTxO by Address local state query
・Pallas Pull Request #340 - add stake distribution local state query
・Pallas Pull Request #335 - add cbor decoder for HardForkQuery
・Pallas Pull Request #333 - fix: add missing feature gate flag to tokio dependency
・Pallas Pull Request #322 - add get_current_pparams local state query

Conclusion
